electrical_conductivity(T).note: A candidate Schulz (1991) resistivity correlation was found but its extracted units did not sanity-check against known Pb-17Li resistivity (~90-110 microOhm-cm). structural_family.name: low-chromium ODS FeCrAl
structural_family.note: Unlike Pb-17Li, this is a developmental alloy family, not a standardized reference material. Dose-dependent properties (creep, swelling, fracture toughness with He, irradiated strength) have no generic published correlation and depend on the specific alloy composition/processing route. Fabricating plausible-looking values here would be exactly the failure mode this material card's fail-closed design exists to prevent. Requires supplier data sheet or irradiation campaign results.
